## SEO Agent – 12 Change Deployment & Notifications
The SEO Agent POSTs signed events here (set N8N_EVENTS_WEBHOOK_URL=<n8n>/webhook/seo-events and the same N8N_EVENTS_SECRET in both). change.approved → deployment pipeline (backup → deploy → verify → re-score; live only if an admin enabled it). deployment.completed (verified) / rollback.completed → notification. Failures are alerted by the API itself. n8n never approves or rolls back – those are human actions in the app.

Requires n8n env vars: SEO_API_URL, SEO_API_KEY (service key), SEO_PROJECT_ID. All logic runs in the SEO Agent API; every call is retried 3× and failures trigger the Error Handler workflow.
